sections.text: I am the Oblation, the Sacrifice and the Worship; I am the Fuel and the Chant, I am the Butter offered to the fire, I am the Fire itself, and I am the Act of offering.
I am the Father of the universe and its Mother; I am its Nourisher and its Grandfather; I am the Knowable and the Pure; I am Om; and I am the Sacred Scriptures.
गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्।
I am the Goal, the Sustainer, the Lord, the Witness, the Home, the Shelter, the Lover and the Origin; I am Life and Death; I am the Fountain and the Seed Imperishable.

We had been discussing chapter nine, Raja Vidya, Raja Guhya yoga -- Yoga of King of Secrets and King of knowledge. So from chapters one through six we have seen who I am and how I should work in this world with the Spirit of Yajna. Because those actions are not binding.
All others are binding. Then we have looked in chapter seven, the lower nature of the supreme, that which is manifest all around me. And then in chapter eight we have seen his higher nature which is unmanifest, supporting all the beings.
The secret still is what is my relationship with him is the secret. Having known all that, I still cannot find how I can relate to Him. So now chapter nine gives us the indication of what is your relationship with the Supreme? The Bhagavan, the Almighty, my Creator.
So in the beginning he said that my relationship to this prakriti which you are part of it. Im trying to find out my relationship with Him. I already learned in chapter 8 that Im nothing but a part of this manifest world.
Therefore Im nothing but a prakriti. See, my relationship to this manifest world, Bhagavan said, is that of a relationship less relation. So he said that this entire Jagat of moving and unmoving is pervaded by me and presided by me, Adiyakshaina.
I keep eye on it, but I dont take part in it. This Jagat is in me, but Im not in them. They are also not in.
From my perspective, from the perspective of the supreme, this Jagat does not exist and therefore it is not in me. So therefore he says, this relationship of this Prakriti and the supreme is that of no relationship but a perceived relationship. Relationship which can be associated with each other but have no real association.
This entire Jagat is pervaded by me and Chara Nachar, moving and unmoving. I send them forth by my yoga Maya. At the beginning of the cycle I send those multitude of beings.
Same multitude of beings will merge into me at the end of the cycle. And again they will start all over again. Those who do not recognize this fact because of their limited understanding of the nature of the supreme, they try to find the perfection which truly belongs to the supreme through Mogasa, Moga Karma.
By the vain desires and vain actions. Im trying to achieve something which can only be achieved at the level of perfection. Im trying to achieve it with my little efforts here and there.
Bhagavan says, therefore they cannot achieve it. But then there are others who recognize this fact that if my goal is that high, then I have to align myself with that high of an entity. The one who truly have these qualities.
How do you do strategic planning? You align your capabilities with the opportunities. When you combine the two, thats your strategy. But if I dont have capabilities and I just keep looking at opportunities, thats not really a strategy.
My strategy in life is to get perfect happiness. I see opportunity there -- theres got to be somewhere, a state where I can be happy all the time. What I miss out on is: am I capable? So I am not really aligning these two.
I have two different entities -- one who is very limited in capability, trying to achieve something which is highly unachievable through limited means. Bhagavan said that those who recognize this align themselves with the supreme. They focus single-pointedly to identify themselves with that supreme who is pervading everywhere.
And to do that, they use different methods. Different people use different methods. Once they recognize the fact that the perfect happiness is not achievable by actions in this world of Prakriti -- the world of objects, emotions and thoughts as shown in s BMI chart -- this world can never give you the perfect happiness, no matter how hard you try.
They align with the supreme, the work in this world. But their goal is aligned with the Mahatmas. Those great souls who realize that perfect happiness can only be found by aligning with one who is perfect.
They achieve that in many different ways. Some consider him to be only one -- the one that exists and nothing else can exist. And as we have seen in our three schools of thought, thats Advaita.
I and him are no different from each other. I am under the spell of Maya. Thats the only difference.
Some see it as divided into many. So at least its more than one -- Creator and creation. These two, some believe, will never be able to coincide with each other.
Creation will always remain creation, Creator will always remain Creator. From that perspective also people can reach Him. Or I say bahudha vishvatomukham.
He is everywhere, in everything I see. And every being I see is him alone. Every eye I see, every leg I see, every mouth I see -- its all his expressions.
Others see it that way, as we have seen in Vishishtadvaita. He is the whole and what I see is just a part. I have a narrow perspective on life.
Therefore I cannot see him in his complete glory. But wherever I see, I see his glimpse. Thats Visheshta Advaita.
So Bhagavan said, any which way you can approach me, it is all coming to me only. Because I am everything. If you pay money to Chinmaya Mission, whether at this center or any other center, eventually it all goes to Chinmaya Mission.
It really doesnt matter. Any efforts you put in aligning yourself with the supreme, in whatever manner -- whether its Advaita, Dvaita, or Vishishtadvaita -- seeing him as father, mother, brother, supporter. And therefore they will be successful as long as they align with me in any which way.
Because thats all coming to me. Because I am the father of this entire Jagat -- Mata Dhata Pitamaha. As we have said, I am also mother, sustainer, grandfather.
Vedyam, Pavitram, Omkaram. I am that which is indicated in the Vedas as the supreme reality, as Om, which encompasses all four states of existence. Three which I am very aware which is my dream world, deep sleep and waking world.
In the fourth one which supports all these three, he said thats indicated by Om. Therefore whatever is indicated in the Rukh Saam and Yajuho in these books of knowledge about his nature. Any which way you approach me is acceptable.
You will reach me as long as your goal is to reach me. Gatihi Bharata Prabhuhu Sakshi Nivasah Bhagawan Vidyas uses the approach sometimes. I tell our young architects: it has to be idiot-proof.
Consider your contractor the greatest fool on this planet, and then do your documents. That way you will not make the mistake of him misunderstanding you. Make it so clear, so obvious that you hit the lowest denominator.
Bhagavan through Vedavyasa doesnt want to leave anything out. In case you missed it in Pitahamasya Jagato Mata Dhata -- now he adds Gatihi. I am the goal Bharata.
I am the supporter Prabhu. I am the Lord Saksihi. Anything that is happening in this world, I am the witness.
You may think that when you are doing something bad, nobody is seeing. But Bhagavan is watching that. Because Bhagavan is every including your own self.
It means you will know what you have done. Therefore I am always witness as you. I am the refuge when I am in trouble.
Im actually invoking my own capacity to overcome my difficulties. We have talked about many times. Friend is a very special relationship.
In any other relationship, I have to be correct in my behavior and approach for that relationship to work. But friends? Any which way we meet after a long time, they curse each other and do all the funny things, hit each other. A friend is one who supports you no matter how wrong you are.
Anytime I want to do something and I tell my friend Deepak, Im trying to do this, he says, Thats not a good idea. I say, No, but that will be fun in the end. He says, Okay, then if you really want to do it, lets go and do it. Just before exams, we did this all the time. Id say, Deepak, lets go see a movie. Hed say, But tomorrow you have an exam. Id say, I think I can make it up. And in the end he would say, Okay, then lets go. A friend will support you even when you are wrong, even if he knows you are going down the wrong path and going to suffer through it. Bhagavan says, I am that friend.
Anytime you do something wrong, I know. I am telling you as your conscience. Still you want to do it? I am the beginning and the end. Sthanam -- also the place where you exist, the support.
For anything to exist in space and time, you need inertia. Bhagavan says, I am the Sthanam, that space where you exist. Im also the treasure house.
When I need knowledge -- O Bhagavan, O Saraswati Mata, Saraswati Puja. I want wealth -- Lakshmi Mata. I am afraid -- Hanuman Ji or Durga Mata.
Whatever you want. I am the treasure house of anything you want. We have discussed this concept before.
I am the source, the seed. But very different than any other source which we know. Every other source will be depleted once you exercise it.
That source will be depleted. Thats why worried about this. Fossil fuel will be depleted or any seed.
Once you use that seed and the tree comes out, the seed is destroyed. Immutable seed, the tree will come out or whatever the product. I still remain intact.
Therefore any method which you apply is still coming to me. I am the one who bakes you as the sun. Aham Varsam, I rain down as rains.
Nigruhani Utsradami I also hold and I also throw you out. I send you back Amrutham Chaya. None of us will ever have any experience of not existing.
Not a single being has ever existed in this universe who has the experience of not existing. We assume we will not exist because Gandhiji is not here, my father is not here. So its an assumed position that I will not exist.
However, you cant find one person in the entire history of the human race who can say, Yeah, I know what it means to not exist. Because everyone is only there when they think they are existing. Amritam -- immortality. Cha Eva Mrityustra -- and also death.
The death which I see decaying every day. Death and decay which I see. I as a baby have died and become a toddler.
Toddler died and became a boy. And boy died, became a young man. A young man died into the old man.
And now I think my next stage is not existing. Im constantly seeing death. Bhagawan says thats also me.
Sat, Asatya Aham Arjuna. O Arjuna in the head and Sat, that which is existing as real and also Asat that which is unreal. So Sat can be viewed in many different ways.
That which is temporary is Asat. That which is permanent is Sat. That which is cause is Sat.
That which we see as effect is Asat. Everything in this world is nothing but an effect of a cause. The cause remains intact throughout all the variations and modifications of the effect.
Standard examples we have seen are that of gold and gold bangles. I also use the example of space: space is Sat; all conditioned spaces -- room space, cathedral space, casino space -- are Asat.

In these verses, Krishna declares: I am the ritual, the sacrifice, the offering, the fire, and the act of offering (aham kratur aham yajnah). He is not just one element of worship - He is every element. This reveals a profound truth: in any spiritual practice, the worshipper, the worshipped, and the act of worship are all expressions of the same reality. There is no separation between subject, object, and action. When you offer a prayer, who is praying to whom? The consciousness in you reaches toward... consciousness itself.
I am the Father, Mother, Grandfather, Sustainer of the universe (pitaham asya jagato mata dhata pitamahah). Whatever role you seek the Divine in, that role is fulfilled. I am the Goal, the Supporter, the Lord, the Witness, the Abode, the Refuge, the Friend (gatir bharta prabhuh sakshi nivasah saranam suhrt). Notice especially suhrt - the friend. A friend supports you even when you are wrong, unlike other relationships that demand correct behavior. The Divine is that friend who accompanies you through every mistake, never abandoning you.
Most remarkably, Krishna says: I am the imperishable seed (bijam avyayam). Unlike ordinary seeds that are destroyed when they sprout, the Divine remains unchanged though the entire universe emerges from it. This week, contemplate: What remains unchanged through all your lifes transformations - childhood to adulthood, joy to sorrow, health to illness? That unchanging witness-awareness is the avyaya bija, the imperishable seed that is your true identity and the source of all.
